info.name: Cryptomator vaults
info.summary: Browse your Cryptomator vaults in the Files app; the password never leaves the browser
info.description:
Browse, preview and download the files of a Cryptomator vault stored in your Nextcloud, in the Files app, without installing Cryptomator.
- **In Files:** *Vaults* in the navigation lists your vaults; an unlocked vault is browsed in Files' own list, with its folders, breadcrumbs, sorting and grid view - **Recognised as you open it:** a vault's folder in your files shows a notice that opens the vault - **Unlocked in your browser:** the password, the vault's keys and every decrypted name and file stay in the browser tab; the server only sends the encrypted files, as it does for Cryptomator itself - **Locks itself** after 15 minutes without use, when you choose Lock, or when you leave the page - **Read only:** nothing is written to the vault; use Cryptomator to change it - Vault format 8 (Cryptomator 1.6 and later), both cipher combinations
Not affiliated with Skymatic GmbH, the makers of Cryptomator.
info.author: Dawid Ciepiela
